$description: Agent-chat kit contract (wave-XIV W2, per copilot-chat-for-neu + claude-agent-sdk-for-neu): composer mode/model row, diff-review card, plan list, checkpoint marker, usage meter, #file mention, attachments. Only semantic refs — every color follows the theme cascade, status hues stay inside the state.* dictionary.

rowEdge.$description: Hairline between the input area and the mode/model row.

modelText.$description: Model picker label — secondary hierarchy under the input.

addText.$description: Added-line counter — success dictionary, never a raw green.

edge.$description: Marker hairline across the feed — a restore boundary, not a status.

dot.$description: Checkpoint dot — accent, distinct from state hues (a point, not a status).

meterWarn.$description: Context fill above the warn threshold.

meterError.$description: Context fill at/above the error threshold (nearly full).

label.$description: Meter captions — tertiary, still ≥4.5:1 by contract.

bg.$description: #file chip ground — accent tint, same family as selected pills.

text.$description: Mention path — AA-gated on the primarySoft tint by contract.
